interactions.conditions: Nominal XFCN single-row PZ254 male to PM254 female series pairing at 2.54 mm pitch; does not prove PCB alignment or polarity
Board P JOUT1 and Board B J5 both use pins 1/2 power, 3 ATT, 4 PDOK, and 5/6 ground; verify physical pin-1-to-pin-1 orientation and continuity before power

Review PCB-to-PCB spacing and interference, fully seat the unkeyed pair, add appropriate mechanical retention, continuity-test all six nets with power absent, then current-limit first power and check connector temperature under maximum intended load
